title: Script table cached event lookup
summary: Recovered VA 0x4f5ca0 (RVA 0xf5ca0), 81 bytes. Select a 20-byte hash node using the string hash at +8 and the table exponent byte at +7. Follow +16 links, matching key tag 4 and string pointer identity. Return the non-nil value in place, or OR the event bit into table byte +6 and return null. Fields otherwise remain untouched. Original ABI is ECX=table, EDX=event, one caller-cleaned stack string, EAX=result; GCC regparm(3) with an unused EAX argument exactly expresses this custom convention. Portable implementation uses a genuine member method. Callers at 0x4f11d0, 0x4f1c20, 0x4f2877, 0x4f29ba and 0x4f2aa4/0x4f2ad1 check cache bits 0..4 before lookup; lookup itself does not check cache. Direct disassembly and the original zero nil words at 0x99a41c were inspected. Accepted reference bytes were compared directly to the immutable executable. No Ghidra import was needed for this bounded instruction sequence.
test_description: GCC i386 fixed-flag test_main directly compares the member method with original_script_table_cached_event_lookup, then independently checks the expected result and complete table bytes. Each case also checks all node and string bytes after the original and after the recovered method, repeats the original lookup to verify cache idempotence, and checks FS head restoration after each original call following successful test_install_fs. The full locally mapped suite has 26112 cases: bucket exponents 0..3, 32..35 and 255; low hashes 0..7 and additional high-bit hashes; event indices 0,1,2,3,4,7,8,15,31,32,33,39,40,255,UINT32_MAX; flags 0,0x55,0x80,0xff; bucket hit, bucket nil, chain hit, chain nil, wrong key tag, same-content different key pointer, duplicate matching keys, and true miss. Exact 8-byte data-only .oracle_nil fixture is locally linked at 0x99a41c and remains unchanged. Without that mapping the harness explicitly skips true misses and still runs 21760 core cases, including explicit nil paths. The accepted 81-byte assembly reference was compared byte-for-byte to Game.exe. GCC behavioral tests pass both mappings. VS2013 Update 5 implementation compilation passes O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Behavior-validated readable source; no compiler-generated byte match claimed.
True missing-key oracle tests require .oracle_nil at 0x99a41c. They passed locally with that exact mapping; the harness reports a skip if a trusted linker does not map this data fixture.
Assumes the original immutable shared nil tag remains zero. Its observed zero data is folded into the miss branch for portability.

Requires valid table, string, bucket storage and acyclic readable chains. Invalid pointers, out-of-range bucket storage and cyclic chains are outside the tested contract; no new validation is invented.
Unknown table/string fields remain opaque. Struct offsets describe i386; a native 64-bit port uses native pointers and must translate serialized or external i386 memory separately.
The genuine C++ member is a portable semantic interface rather than a drop-in binary shim for the original custom register ABI. Only test.cpp carries the GCC custom-ABI oracle declaration.
Normal-path FS restoration is tested. No exceptions, VM allocation, string interning or full event dispatch is recovered.
